title: cells add maps change_class behavior to trace.behavior_change=true by default
action: Review P3-5 (close-lands-bookkeeping-20260810): a cell authored with change_class 'behavior' but no explicit trace.behavior_change landed with trace.behavior_change=false, so resolve_declared_behavior_change (handlers_close.rs:40-53) read the explicit false and the scribing-debt door never armed for a genuine behavior change. Fix at authoring: when cells add (and cells update if it can set change_class) receives change_class 'behavior' and the payload does NOT explicitly set trace.behavior_change, default it to true; an explicit false in the payload is respected (the author opted out on purpose). Locate the exact authoring site that writes the default false first — if the file is not handlers_add.rs, follow the real path and note it in the trace. TDD: red test proving a change_class-behavior cell added without the flag now resolves as behavior change via resolve_declared_behavior_change; explicit-false test stays false; non-behavior classes unchanged.

truths: a cell added with change_class behavior and no explicit flag counts as behavior change at the debt door
other change_class values keep today's behavior

artifacts.substantive: authoring default plus tests (or the real authoring site, named in the trace)

trace.outcome: cells add defaults trace.behavior_change=true for change_class behavior when unset (normalize_new_cell in validate.rs — declared file handlers_add.rs does not exist, real site followed per cell instruction); explicit false respected; other classes unchanged
